brief.title: THE GAZE
brief.sub: Where its light rests, lightning follows.

do.title: SECTOR 3-3 · THE CITADEL
do.sub: The citadel that ordered the lockdown. It is still watching.

do.title: CONDUCTOR
do.sub: Only the eye's lightning breaks a conductor.

do.title: THE GATEHOUSE
do.sub: The portcullis hangs from three clamps.

do.title: THE ARMOURY
do.sub: Crack a plate with the eye's lightning; in the quench below, the Bastion can be hurt.

do.title: THE AUTHORITY
do.sub: Sunder its armour off, then Rail the cores behind it.
